name: Glassnode
tagline: On-chain market intelligence metrics for institutional crypto analysis
description: Glassnode provides REST APIs delivering institutional-grade on-chain and market intelligence metrics across Bitcoin, Ethereum, and major crypto assets—including supply dynamics, exchange flows, profitability indicators, network activity, and derivatives data for quantitative research and trading systems.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter (also accepted as X-Api-Key header per docs); self-serve from Glassnode Studio account settings

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan includes limited metrics and rate limits (exact quota varies by plan; check studio for current allotment)
pricing.paid_plans: Standard, Professional, and Enterprise tiers with expanded metric catalogs and higher rate limits

rate_limits: Plan-dependent; not fully published without account—check Glassnode Studio/API settings for your tier
use_cases: fetch Bitcoin USD closing price history for backtests
get exchange netflow metrics for on-chain flow analysis
query realized profit/loss indicators by asset
pull active address and network activity time series
export on-chain supply metrics as CSV for quant models
